summary.text: Ivan Posey is a Democratic member of the Wyoming House of Representatives from District 33, serving since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ivan Posey served in the United States Army and later worked for the USDA Forest Service in the Shoshone National Forest and as culture director for Arapahoe School in the Fremont County School District #38.
Posey is an enrolled member of the Eastern Shoshone tribe and is also Northern Cheyenne and Northern Arapaho.

Posey was appointed by Gov. Dave Freudenthal to serve as the first Tribal Liaison for the Shoshone and Arapaho Tribes of the Wind River Indian Reservation from 2003 to 2004, and Posey served on the Shoshone Business Council from 1994 to 2002 and 2004 to 2016.
Posey also founded the Eastern Shoshone Boys and Girls Club and served as chairman of the Rocky Mountain Tribal Leaders Council.
Posey assumed office in the Wyoming House of Representatives on January 6, 2025, succeeding Sarah Penn.
For 2025-2026, Posey is co-chair of the Select Committee on Tribal Relations and sits on the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee.
